role: The skill corpus. One directory per skill; the skill itself is SKILL.md at that directory's root.

invariants.statement: Every directory directly under this package contains SKILL.md.
invariants.why: A skill directory is discovered by its position, not by its contents. One without SKILL.md is offered to the agent and then loads nothing, which surfaces as a skill that mysteriously does not apply rather than as a missing file.

invariants.statement: Every SKILL.md opens with a YAML frontmatter fence and declares both name and description.
invariants.why: The description is the entire basis on which a skill is selected for a task. A skill with no description is never chosen, and a skill with no name cannot be invoked by /<name>; both fail as silence rather than as an error.

counterexample.content:
---
description: fix DRC violations
---

Fix them.

counterexample.proves: a missing frontmatter fence is caught
counterexample.content:
# drc-fix

name: drc-fix
description: fix DRC violations

invariants.statement: No SKILL.md may contain an absolute /home/<user> path; the placeholder form /home/<your-user> is the way to show one.
invariants.why: Skills are read verbatim by the agent as instructions. An author's home path in a skill becomes a path the agent tries to use on someone else's machine.

counterexample.content:
---
name: sta-review
description: review timing
---

Open /home/someuser/reports/sta.rpt.
